entry.pre_arrival: Apply through the official eVisa system, choose the accurate purpose and wait for issuance before flying.
entry.max_stay: Up to 90 days; official fee USD25 single-entry or USD50 multiple-entry.

tourism.detail: Australians are eligible for up to 90 days, single or multiple entry.
tourism.next: Apply directly through the national portal and wait for issuance before travel.

meetings.route: eVisa with accurate business purpose; sponsored DN route where the host prefers
meetings.detail: Meetings and trade discussions can use the published entry system without becoming local service delivery.
meetings.next: State the actual business purpose and carry the invitation.

conference.route: eVisa with summit or conference purpose
conference.detail: The eVisa form includes a conference purpose; passive attendance remains separate from speaker or trainer work.
conference.next: If joining the program, have the organiser activate the short-expert or work route.

unpaid-speaking.route: Qualifying under-90-day expert assignment plus host notice
unpaid-speaking.detail: Active delivery can use the short foreign-worker exemption when the person and assignment meet the manager, executive, expert or technical-worker criteria.
unpaid-speaking.next: Have the Vietnamese host confirm the expert classification and notify the authority at least three working days before delivery.

paid-speaking.route: Short-expert exemption when qualified; otherwise LĐ2 plus work permit
paid-speaking.detail: A host can activate a genuine short expert assignment; normal local employment or a non-qualifying service uses the work-permit path.
paid-speaking.next: Put credentials, contract, fee, dates and duties into the host's classification.

book-launch.route: Short-expert or work route for active delivery; Vietnamese publisher or bookshop for retail
book-launch.detail: Rights and publisher meetings can stay in the business lane, while a talk, workshop and sales operation should be split.
book-launch.next: Let a local seller handle stock and receipts, then classify any paid or unpaid appearance.

ai-teaching.route: Under-90-day expert exemption plus host notice; LĐ2/work permit for longer teaching
ai-teaching.detail: Science, technology, innovation and digital-transformation experts also have selective exemption possibilities, and a high-threshold digital-professional route can support up to five years.
ai-teaching.next: Have the university, lab, company or province test the credentials against the current expert criteria.

remote-work.detail: The eVisa provides entry but the official visa list does not expressly create a general overseas-remote-work status.
remote-work.next: Pre-clear immigration, labour and tax treatment if Vietnam becomes a remote-work base.

entrepreneur.route: DN2 for establishment activity; investor code and work exemption follow actual capital
entrepreneur.detail: Investor classes begin at different capital levels; an ownership-based work exemption starts at VND3 billion for qualifying company roles.
entrepreneur.next: Choose negotiation, company establishment, investment amount and operating role as separate decisions.

trade.route: eVisa for trade discussions; DN2 or investor/company structure for operation
trade.detail: Offering services, establishing a commercial presence and treaty activity can use DN2, while market-access rules sit under investment law.
trade.next: Use the initial trip for suppliers and partners, then model commercial presence and work status.

artist.route: Host-selected entry and labour route plus performance approval
artist.detail: A foreign performance can require three layers: entry, labour permission and organiser-obtained cultural approval under Decree 144/2020.
artist.next: Have the Vietnamese promoter coordinate all three layers and classify every venue.

mixed-mission.route: eVisa front door plus one Vietnamese host coordinating expert, work, investment or cultural layers
mixed-mission.detail: Vietnam's 90-day eVisa is flexible for arrival; the host is the switchboard for active delivery.
mixed-mission.next: Send the host one schedule separating attendance, delivery, payment, sales, performance and company activity.
